title: Sprint 14 baseline freeze: acceptance reconciliation, historical migrations and Sprint 15 entry gate
body:
## Owner-approved baseline gate (2026-10-19)
OpsControl is in **development/integration**, with **no production deployment or production database**. The synchronized GitHub/local `main` is a **code baseline**, not a production release or acceptance sign-off. Preserve its verified Sprint 14 state as the comparison point; do not claim Sprints 1–14 are fully accepted.

### Mandatory order
1. Freeze/reference the current main baseline; record commit SHA and CI evidence without altering production (none exists).
2. Reconcile the approved 42-sprint whiteboard, preserving its exact scope and dependencies.
3. Complete Section A verification:
   - Sprint 09: cross-module regression, external-client scoping, bounded pagination, schema preservation.
   - Sprint 10: ARCH-001 / ARCH-ETL-001 / IMP-001–062 requirements-to-code traceability, no architecture rewrite.
   - Sprint 11: production capability matrix, supported/unsupported integrations, readiness and risk register (planning only, no production claim).
   - Sprint 12: service catalog, shared-resource ownership, canonical identity, tenant-safe relationships.
   - Sprint 13: coverage contracts, freshness, observed versus registered inventory and blind spots.
   - Sprint 14: source clock skew, event/receipt timestamps, telemetry quality.
4. **P0:** Historical migration validation on **disposable PostgreSQL only**: fresh-to-head, populated historical revision-to-head, retention/integrity, tenant constraints, supported downgrade/re-upgrade, and evidence. No production DB exists.
5. Triage pending implementation and bug-fix priorities, RBAC/tenant boundaries, UAT and RAT/RT-LABS. Classify each CI failure as implemented defect, pending implementation, lab dependency or future-sprint scope. Do not weaken coverage >=80% or CI/security gates.
6. Only after explicit Sprint 15 entry approval: Section B Sprint 15 agent/collector enrollment, credential/certificate lifecycle/revocation; Sprint 16 network profiles, proxy/TLS and unreachable-source handling. Preserve remainder of Section B Sprints 17–19 and full 42-sprint roadmap.

### Current evidence and unresolved gates
- Integration PR #37 history is included in main; main one commit ahead when last compared. Branch containment != acceptance.
- Integration commit b7e6e45: 9 passing / 9 failing pull-request workflows; do not represent these as current main's independent certification.
- Historical ORM model registration and migration metadata inspected; **end-to-end historical migration success not established**.
- Continuous-quality workflow reported 45.81% coverage after acceptance failures; investigate complete collection before comparing to 80%.
- Consolidated UAT, customer/access fixtures, native monitoring, infrastructure, Pentaho ETL and other acceptance checks remain to be triaged by actual implemented scope.
- Track issue evidence and RAT/RT-LABS separately. Protect PR #33. No merge/deployment/production actions authorized by this tracking issue.

### Sign-off checklist
- [ ] Record immutable main baseline commit and corresponding CI evidence.
- [ ] Complete Sprint 09–12 verification matrix with code/test references.
- [ ] Verify Sprint 13–14 implementation and acceptance or explicitly defer gaps.
- [ ] Historical fresh/populated migration probes pass in disposable PostgreSQL with logs.
- [ ] Resolve or disposition implemented-scope defects and UAT findings.
- [ ] Reconcile all 42 sprint scopes and pending priority inventory.
- [ ] Obtain explicit owner approval for Sprint 15 entry.
